name: Romanian 24h Championship 2024

venue.name: [Colegiul Tehnologic Viaceslav Harnaj](https://www.colegiulharnaj.ro/)
venue.details: Two classrooms at the same floor, please follow the signs. The entrance from Strada Horia Macelariu

information:
**ANUNT IMPORTANT**
Aceasta competitie se va desfasura non stop pe parcursul a 24 de ore. Este o competitie diferita si solicitanta.
Fiecare eveniment are doua runde. Prima runda va fi pe timpul zilei iar a doua pe timpul noptii.
Va rugam parcurgeti toate rubricile de informatii iar apoi sa decideti daca va inscrieti.

-----------------------

**Important Announcement**
This competition will take place non-stop for 24 hours. It's a different and very demanding kind of competition.
All events have two rounds, the first round will take place during the day and the second round during the night.
We ask of you to go through all of the information tabs before making the decision to register or not.
